label: Acknowledgement of Country —
body: We acknowledge the Wurundjeri people of the Kulin Nation as the Traditional Custodians of this Country. We honour their deep and continuing relationship with the western grasslands — living landscapes that have long been cared for through knowledge, practice, and connection. We pay our respects to Elders past and present, and recognise the strength and continuity of culture that endures on this land.
